title: Project Geld candidate bundle (v1)
description: Offline, versioned contract for importing an APPROVED factor/strategy candidate from the Emberforge research project into Project Geld. Bundles are declarative data only. They MUST NOT carry executable Python. Importing a valid bundle places it in research-only quarantine and can never enable paper trading or affect deployed strategies.

signal_spec.description: Declarative specification only. No executable code.

expression.description: Declarative formula in a restricted, non-Python DSL; interpreted by a future engine, never exec()'d.

universe_assumptions.description: Either a structured object, or a list of the symbols the factor was evaluated on (as emitted by Emberforge).

preprocessing.description: Either an ordered array of step objects, or a settings map (as emitted by Emberforge). No executable code.

code_hash.description: Fingerprint of the signal specification. NOT code to execute.
